CANON — KOREAN FACES on every person, named or extra: living eyes with WHITE sclera, a small catchlight, and BLACK ink-black iris and pupil (never brown, hazel, amber, honey, gold, blue, grey, green or purple). Never paint the entire eyeball solid black. A low soft Korean nasal bridge, never a high European, Roman or Persian nose. East Asian bone: single-lidded or low-creased eyes, straight or softly arched brows, broad cheekbones, flatter facial planes, warm ivory to sun-browned skin, straight coarse black hair. Never Western, Latin, or mixed-race features, never deep-set double-lidded western eyes. | KING MUNMU — FACE and garments from attached /ch_munmu.png (face only; invent a new pose). Look: Square jaw, goatee and moustache, confident grin; arms folded when he is pleased with himself. Dress: As king: crimson robe with gold dragon embroidery, blue shoulder pieces, gold Silla crown. Earlier: prince/hwarang stage portraits. Crown: Silla gold crown exactly as the attached museum photo (Cheonmachong / Hwangnamdaechong, 27 to 36 cm tall, as tall again as the face): an OPEN crown with no cap or lining, the hair and topknot showing through it. A NARROW flat gold headband (about a thumb wide) sits level on the forehead. Rising from it, THREE flat sheet-gold tree uprights, one at the centre front and one over each ear: each is a straight vertical stem whose short straight side-branches turn UP at right angles in three or four stacked tiers (like 出), every tip a small bud or heart. At the BACK, two shorter flat antler-shaped uprights angle outward with alternating branches, seen behind the tree uprights, never curling out like horns at the sides. Every upright and the band is hung on fine gold wires with hundreds of small round trembling gold spangles and many curved pale-green jade gogok. From the band at each temple, a long pendant chain of gold leaf-shapes falls past the cheek to the collarbone. Thin, bright, pale gold-silver sheet that trembles and catches light. NEVER a solid basket, never a castle battlement or fence, never horns or deer antlers curving at the sides, never a cap inside, never a European spiked crown or tiara. Demeanor: Cocky, warm, practical; his father's charm with his uncle's spine. #C41E3A as the hard key / specular / bounce in the dark — real light, never a glow aura or body halo. Never: katana; Tang dragon robe in place of Silla court dress. | GOTASO — FACE ONLY from attached /ch_gotaso_gardener.png; ignore the portrait's clothing and dress exactly as "Dress" below (invent a new pose). Hair ornament matches attached /bn_gotaso.png when the head is visible. Look: Fourteen-fifteen, round young face, bright eyes, black hair up with her gilt butterfly binyeo. A girl, never sexualized. Dress: Gardener dress (attached /ch_gotaso_gardener.png): soft PINK silk jeogori with a sage-green collar and dark-blue cuffs, dark-blue goreum, black waistband, cream chima; gilt butterfly binyeo with pink tips; both hands on a dark woven basket of RED flowers — FACE AND GARMENTS from that board. A girl, never sexualized. No mortal white-and-red Daeya dress. Demeanor: Bold, impatient, loves loudly; asks the same question until it is answered. Props: THE GOLD BUTTERFLY (only when the scene names it): a thumb-sized hand-hammered Silla gold butterfly pendant, thin gold sheet with tiny punched dots and three trembling gold spangles, one wing visibly a little larger than the other, hung on a short pink silk cord. Gotaso made it herself. #F0A3C0 as the hard key / specular / bounce in the dark — real light, never a glow aura or body halo. Never: sexualized pose or skin. | KING MUYEOL — FACE ONLY from attached /ch_chunchu_sobyul.png; ignore the portrait's clothing and dress exactly as "Dress" below (invent a new pose). Look: Slim and elegant; shoulder-length loose black hair parted in the middle; amused eyes, small knowing smile. Unmistakably Korean face: BLACK eyes (never brown, blue or grey), a small straight Korean nose with a low bridge, smooth oval face. Dress: Life-lord dress (attached /ch_chunchu_sobyul.png): plain WHITE silk po with a charcoal inner collar, a wide MAGENTA #D8258C sash knotted hard at the waist, thin vertical magenta-crimson streaks like refused ink down the white; shoulder-length loose black hair, thin moustache and goatee stubble, amused half-lid — FACE AND GARMENTS from that board. No crown, no jougwan, no Magenta Devil court silk. Now: Thin moustache and goatee stubble. Now: King Muyeol (stage portrait): royal robes and crown; heavier, tired eyes. Demeanor: Diplomat and strategist: talks with his hands, smiles while calculating, never shouts; half-lidded watchful eyes. #D8258C as the hard key / specular / bounce in the dark — real light, never a glow aura or body halo. Never: front-line armored warrior pose; shouting battle face; katana; Never a Chinese-style hat: no futou, no winged samo, no brimmed black gat; out of battle he wears only the small black Silla jougwan feather cap or a bare topknot with a gold pin.; Never a large or high-bridged nose; never light-coloured eyes.. | KIM YUSHIN — FACE ONLY from attached /ch_kim_yushin_daebyul.png; ignore the portrait's clothing and dress exactly as "Dress" below (invent a new pose). Look: Tall, broad-shouldered, long black hair in a high topknot-ponytail with trailing Silla-blue cloth tails; level hard brows. Unmistakably Korean face: BLACK eyes (never brown, blue or grey), a low soft Korean nasal bridge, never a high European nose. Dress: Death-lord dress (attached /ch_kim_yushin_daebyul.png): heavy BLACK silk po with a white inner collar, a wide bright SILLA-BLUE #2A5FB8 sash knotted hard at the waist; full black beard, high topknot with a dark blue ribbon, loose strands — FACE AND GARMENTS from that board. He STANDS. No armor, no jougwan, no marshal blue po. Now: Old marshal: grey-streaked beard, heavier frame, slower — still stands, still counts. Demeanor: Confucian: he STANDS — never sits in lotus. Weighs, counts, frowns at sums; tight jaw, rare dry half-smile. Grief shows as stillness, not tears. The most feared warrior in all of Samhan: a line goes quiet when the tall Silla helm and the white horse appear. Massive, deliberate, terrifying at a walk; by Hwangsan (65) heavier and slower than Gyebek but still the man armies are built around. #2A5FB8 as the hard key / specular / bounce in the dark — real light, never a glow aura or body halo. Never: sitting in lotus or holding prayer beads; katana, tsuba or curved blade (ignore the sword drawn on his portrait); two swords at once; blue glow aura. | PLACE Surabol (서라벌 (경주)) — attached board /pl_eastern_palace.png; keep this exact architecture and ground. Seorabeol palace: Silla giwa halls, packed-earth yards, timber verandas. | COSTUME CHARTS (attached): cut, collar, sleeve, sash, trouser and skirt shapes of every Samhan figure follow the chart for their kingdom; it is a style chart, so ignore its labels, captions, maps, poses and faces. Named people keep their portrait face and colours; extras and soldiers dress like the chart (a commoner like its commoners, an official like its officials, a soldier like its soldiers). COMMONERS in every Samhan kingdom wear SIMPLE WHITE: plain undyed white or off-white hemp and ramie jackets, wide trousers and skirts, a cloth sash, straw sandals or bare feet, hair in a plain topknot or braid — no dyed silk, no dots, no gold; colour belongs to rank, so a crowd of farmers, porters, servants and townsfolk reads as a field of soft white cloth with the officials' colours standing out of it. Silla: attached /ref_hanbok_silla.png.
